status: Ten static design studies based on inspected source; not an implemented app

screens.title: Team overview
screens.purpose: See the whole team and know who needs attention.

screens.title: Agent workspace
screens.purpose: Observe or control the exact browser an agent uses, alongside its task.

screens.title: Agent chat
screens.purpose: Talk to an agent while keeping conversation distinct from work execution.

screens.title: Menu
screens.purpose: Reach the rest of Worklive without keeping permanent navigation panels open.

screens.title: Project space
screens.purpose: Organize a project brief, assigned team and task progression in one place.

screens.title: Memory and files
screens.purpose: Make memory scope and file provenance visible before context is used.

screens.title: Inbox and review
screens.purpose: Bring questions, blocked work and finished results to the user's attention.

screens.title: Reviewed handoff
screens.purpose: Show exactly which accepted file will become the next agent's input.

screens.title: Create agent
screens.purpose: Create a named identity with provider, role and personality, then give it work separately.

screens.title: Connections and first-run setup
screens.purpose: Make official provider login and recovery understandable without exposing credentials.
